description: This file contains implementations of helper functions and configurations related to the Input Capture Unit (ICU) for digital input hardware, specifically for STM32 microcontrollers using ChibiOS. It includes functions to manage ICU drivers, handle callbacks, and interface with hardware pins for input capture functionalities.

methods.name: finddigital_input_s
methods.description: Finds the digital_input_s structure associated with a given ICUDriver. Returns NULL if not found and triggers an error.

methods.name: icuWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on input width measurement; invokes registered width listeners.

methods.name: icuPeriordCallBack
methods.description: Callback invoked on period event; invokes registered period listeners.

methods.name: getAlternateFunctions
methods.description: Returns the alternate function (AF) number for a given ICUDriver.

methods.name: getInputCaptureChannel
methods.description: Determines the ICU channel based on the hardware pin.

methods.name: getInputCaptureDriver
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ICUDriver associated with a specific hardware pin, or NULL if invalid.

methods.name: turnOnCapturePin
methods.description: Configures a hardware pin for input capture by setting its mode.

methods.name: addWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Allocates a digital_input_s structure, associates it with a capture driver, and configures the pin for input capture.

methods.name: removeWaveAnalyzerDriver
methods.description: Removes the driver association for a given pin, stops capture, and releases resources.

methods.name: startInputDriver
methods.description: Starts the input capture on a specified hardware pin with given polarity.
